---
title: ""
format:
  typst:
    output-file: cv.pdf
    papersize: a4
    page-numbering: false
    margin:
      top: 1.5cm
      bottom: 1.5cm
      left: 1.8cm
      right: 1.8cm
    font-size: 10pt
    mainfont: "Libertinus Sans"
    template-partials:
      - typst-template.typ
      - typst-show.typ
execute:
  echo: false
  eval: false
---

```{=typst}
// ── Color palette ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
#let navy  = rgb("#10243E")
#let gold  = rgb("#B68A2E")
#let slate = rgb("#5B6675")
#let mist  = rgb("#F4F5F7")

// ── Global rules ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
#set text(fill: navy)
#set par(justify: false, leading: 0.7em)
#set list(indent: 0pt, body-indent: 1.2em, spacing: 3pt)
#show link: set text(fill: navy)

// ── Helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

// Section heading: bold label + gold underline
#let section(title) = {
  v(12pt)
  text(weight: "bold", size: 11pt, fill: navy)[#title]
  v(3pt)
  line(length: 100%, stroke: (paint: gold, thickness: 0.75pt))
  v(7pt)
}

// Primary experience entry
#let entry(role, org, period, items) = {
  grid(
    columns: (1fr, auto),
    column-gutter: 10pt,
    block(below: 0pt)[
      #text(weight: "bold", size: 10.2pt)[#role]
      #v(2pt)
      #text(style: "italic", size: 9pt, fill: slate)[#org]
    ],
    align(right + top)[
      #text(size: 8.8pt, fill: slate)[#period]
    ],
  )
  v(4pt)
  block(above: 0pt, below: 0pt)[#items]
  v(7pt)
}

// Compact internship entry (single-line summary, no bullets)
#let intern_entry(role, org, period, summary) = {
  grid(
    columns: (1fr, auto),
    column-gutter: 10pt,
    block(below: 0pt)[
      #text(weight: "bold", size: 9.5pt)[#role]
      #h(4pt)
      #text(size: 9pt, fill: slate)[— #org]
      #v(1pt)
      #text(size: 9pt)[#summary]
    ],
    align(right + top)[
      #text(size: 8.5pt, fill: slate)[#period]
    ],
  )
  v(6pt)
}

// Education entry
#let edu_entry(degree, school, year) = {
  block(below: 6pt)[
    #text(weight: "bold", size: 9.5pt)[#degree]
    #h(3pt)
    #text(size: 8.8pt, fill: slate)[(#year)]
    #v(1pt)
    #text(style: "italic", size: 8.9pt, fill: slate)[#school]
  ]
}

// Technical skill row
#let skill_row(label, value) = {
  block(below: 3pt)[
    #grid(
      columns: (2.7cm, 1fr),
      column-gutter: 8pt,
      text(weight: "bold", size: 8.9pt, fill: navy)[#label],
      text(size: 8.9pt)[#value],
    )
  ]
}

// ── PAGE 1 ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

// Header
#grid(
  columns: (1fr, auto),
  column-gutter: 14pt,
  block(below: 0pt)[
    #text(weight: "bold", size: 23pt, fill: navy)[Antoine Lucas]
    #v(4pt)
    #text(weight: "bold", size: 11pt, fill: gold)[Biostatistician & Data Scientist]
    #v(3pt)
    #text(size: 9pt, fill: slate)[Pharma · Cosmetics · Biotech · Paris, France]
  ],
  align(right + horizon)[
    #text(size: 9pt)[#link("mailto:antoine.lucas.fra@gmail.com")[antoine.lucas.fra\@gmail.com]]
    #linebreak()
    #text(size: 9pt)[#link("https://linkedin.com/in/antoinelucasdata")[linkedin.com/in/antoinelucasdata]]
    #linebreak()
    #text(size: 9pt)[#link("https://github.com/antoinelucasfra")[github.com/antoinelucasfra]]
  ],
)

#v(8pt)
#line(length: 100%, stroke: (paint: gold, thickness: 1pt))
#v(8pt)

// Summary
#block(fill: mist, inset: (x: 11pt, y: 9pt), radius: 5pt, width: 100%)[
  #text(size: 9.2pt)[
    Biostatistician and Data Scientist with experience across pharma, cosmetics, and biotech.
    Builds scientific software, statistical workflows, simulation tools, and applied ML in R and Python,
    with a strong focus on readability, reproducibility, and stakeholder-facing delivery.
  ]
]

// ── SELECTED EXPERIENCE ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────

#section([Selected Experience])

#entry(

  [Chanel Parfums Beauté R&D · via Astek / IT&M Stats],
  [Sep 2025 – present],
  [
    - Delivered computer-vision, NLP, and R Shiny tools for formulation R&D — texture and colour analysis, olfactory descriptor mining.
    - Modelled sensory and physico-chemical properties with PLS, Gaussian processes, Bayesian optimisation, and DoE, cutting formulation experiments by 30–40%.
    - Managed delivery and platform lifecycle across Azure ML, Databricks, Posit Connect, Docker, GitHub Actions, and a 20+ app catalog.

)

#entry(
  [Biostatistician],
  [L'Oréal R&I · Scientific Computing · via Astek / IT&M Stats],
  [Nov 2021 – Jul 2023],

    - Supported statistical analyses of exposome and clinical datasets: biophysical, omics, and microbiome data.

#pagebreak(weak: true)

#section([Technical Skills])

#skill_row([Programming], [R · Python · SQL · Bash])
#skill_row([ML & Stats], [scikit-learn · tidymodels · XGBoost · Bayesian optimisation · DoE · PLS · PERMANOVA · survival analysis])

#skill_row([Domains], [GxP · Clinical biostatistics · Multi-omics · Cosmetic R&D])

// ── ADDITIONAL INFORMATION ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

#section([Additional Information])

#grid(
  columns: (1fr, 1fr),
  column-gutter: 16pt,
  block[
    #text(weight: "bold", size: 9.5pt)[Certifications]
    #v(5pt)
    #text(size: 9pt)[GitHub Foundations — GitHub (2024)]
    #v(3pt)
    #text(size: 9pt)[Scrum Master — Agilbee (2023)]
  ],
  block[
    #text(weight: "bold", size: 9.5pt)[Languages]
    #v(5pt)

    #v(3pt)
    #text(size: 9pt)[English (fluent, professional)]
  ],
)
```
